positive_cases.name: long_form_encoded_switch
positive_cases.scenario: PowerShell started with the long encoded command switch.
positive_cases.rationale: Interpreter and encoded option selections both match.

positive_cases.name: short_form_encoded_switch
positive_cases.scenario: PowerShell started with the short encoded command switch.
positive_cases.rationale: Interpreter and encoded option selections both match.

negative_cases.name: plain_command
negative_cases.scenario: PowerShell started with a readable command.
negative_cases.rationale: Interpreter matches but no encoded option is present.

negative_cases.name: script_file_execution
negative_cases.scenario: PowerShell executing an approved script file.
negative_cases.rationale: Interpreter matches but the argument is a file path.

negative_cases.name: other_tool_encoded_argument
negative_cases.scenario: Unrelated utility using a similarly named argument.
negative_cases.rationale: The option text matches but the image is not PowerShell.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
